description: This file defines the ViewFactory class responsible for loading and initializing different view objects within the SuiteCRM MVC architecture. It handles selecting the appropriate view class and configuration based on module, view type, and customizations, and provides methods for instantiating views from files or classes.

classes.name: ViewFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading and instantiating view objects based on parameters, customizations, and configurations within the SuiteCRM MVC framework.

methods.name: loadView
methods.description: Loads and returns the appropriate view object based on type, module, bean, and target module, defaulting to SugarView if no specific view is found.

methods.name: _loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and applies view configuration options from external files based on the view type, module, and request parameters.

methods.name: _buildFromFile
methods.description: Includes a PHP file and constructs an instance of the view class defined within, with fallbacks to generic SugarView.

methods.name: _buildClass
methods.description: Instantiates a given view class, initializes it with the bean and object map, and ensures it is a SugarView.
